body:
PR #2759 (STORY-1854) is ready for review at head 6fd32d79de. main is merged in.

Gate: check-ci-fast green (31 gates). check-ci-compile green after merging main. check-templates OK. Targeted tests pass: aida-core scaffolding 180, aida-core templates 24, aida-cli-lib implementer_preflight 21. tests/test_cargo_timeout_guard.sh passes 20/20.

Per the aida-host constraint (msg 489389f1): nothing assumes STORY-100 enforcement. Every sentence that says the wrapper starts or enforces the budget says "once aida-host STORY-100 ships". The hook stays warn-only: it always exits 0 and returns additionalContext.

Two calls for you:
1. implementer_preflight now passes its budget as AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT. Its outer deadline is now a 2x backstop. Until STORY-100 ships, that means a hung preflight build can take up to 2h, not 1h.
2. The hook is scaffolded into user projects: it is on by default for Claude via include_cargo_timeout_hook. For Codex it ships through the codex-hooks.json parity wiring.
subject: PR-2759 STORY-1854 ready
